description: This script builds and writes an official channel catalog in JSON format by scanning subdirectories of an 'extensions' folder for package.json files, extracting metadata related to openclaw channels, and saving the assembled catalog to a specified path.

methods.name: buildOfficialChannelCatalog
methods.description: Scans the 'extensions' directory for package.json files, constructs catalog entries for valid packages, and returns the sorted catalog object.

methods.name: writeOfficialChannelCatalog
methods.description: Creates the catalog using buildOfficialChannelCatalog and writes it to a file specified by OFFICIAL_CHANNEL_CATALOG_RELATIVE_PATH.
